trust_decision.summary: A project member's effective permissions are resolved from the stored role slug. A DB role row with that slug, looked up across all projects, overrides the built-in permission table. The decision is made in ProjectMiddleware and in SqlDb.GetTemplatePermission; custom-role slugs are never checked against the built-in slugs.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'custom-role slug collision', so an engineer goes to role creation validation (ValidateRole) first. The OSS create handler is a 404 stub (pro/api/roles.go:49-51), which points them at the model validator.

fix_sites.entry_point: Store.GetProjectOrGlobalRoleBySlug, called by ProjectMiddleware, GetTemplatePermission, AddUser/UpdateUser (api/projects/users.go:90,180)
POST /api/project/{project_id}/roles and /api/admin/roles (api/router.go:354,227); handlers are closed-source pro stubs in this tree (pro/api/roles.go:28-30,49-51)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: db/sql/template.go:485-512 (GetTemplatePermission resolves the role inside the store, apart from the middleware) and db/sql/role.go:59-63 (unscoped query)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once custom roles can no longer reuse built-in slugs and the middleware gates the lookup on IsValid, a solver can argue that the store-level template-permission lookup and the cross-project query scope are a separate data-layer concern. The Bolt copy can be dismissed as a deprecated backend.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Real custom roles (non-built-in slugs, project-scoped or global with project_id NULL) must still resolve to their DB permissions, both in ProjectMiddleware and for template permissions. Built-in users must still get template_role extras. An over-broad fix that drops the DB lookup or demands project_id=? (rejecting global roles) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: built-in slug reused by a project custom role (owner/manager/task_runner/guest)
custom role from another project resolved by an unscoped slug lookup

O7_producer.where: db/sql/role.go:59-63 (slug -> Role row lookup feeding permissions); db/ProjectUser.go:22-27 (built-in table)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BoltDB GetProjectOrGlobalRoleBySlug still matches any project's role by slug; the SQL project scoping was not mirrored, so AddUser/UpdateUser validation and middleware custom-role resolution stay cross-project on Bolt
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: BoltDB is marked deprecated (util/config.go:39, cli/setup/setup.go:114), and the built-in-shadowing part is already closed by the store-agnostic IsValid gate in the middleware
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: db/bolt package, 2 packages from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Project-scoped role mutation by slug only: UpdateRole/DeleteRole match on slug with no project_id, in both SQL and Bolt
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the handlers that call them are closed-source pro stubs here (pro/api/roles.go:57-63), and this is cross-project role tampering rather than slug collision
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the scoped-query fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AddTemplatePerm stores the client-supplied role_slug and permission bitmask without checking that the slug is a custom role of this project; a planted copy without the FK (or on Bolt) would let a manager grant a built-in slug extra template permissions
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the handler binds the struct and inserts it directly; only the FK at db/sql/migrations/v2.17.1.sql:19 limits it today

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the migrate/import restore path calls CreateRole with the original slug and skips ValidateRole
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: a save/reload path that never calls the validator; a maintainer would reasonably treat migration data as trusted

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second store implementation of the same lookup, left unscoped
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the Bolt and SQL stores are maintained in parallel, and the fix touched only SQL

O9_family: authorization / privilege escalation via identifier collision (role-slug shadowing of built-in roles, plus unscoped cross-project lookup)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.24.6 (go.mod:3); the web UI (Vue) is not needed for API tests
services: none required with SQLite or Bolt; MySQL/Postgres optional
O10_build.project_tests: db/ProjectUser_test.go (built-in role permission table); no existing tests for role resolution or middleware; the fix adds db/Role_test.go (unit tests for ValidateRole)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject built-in slugs in ValidateRole only, leaving ProjectMiddleware and GetTemplatePermission still preferring a DB row over the built-in table, and the slug query still unscoped by project

out_of_scope_notes: The OSS role-create/update/delete handlers are 404 stubs (pro/api/roles.go:28-63) and ValidateRole has no caller in this tree. Hidden tests must seed role rows directly or unit-test ValidateRole; the HTTP creation path cannot be exercised.
UpdateUser reads 'projectUserRole' from context, which ProjectMiddleware sets for the requesting user (api/projects/users.go:164; api/projects/project.go:76); not pursued.
